title: Pre-market brief
body: Pehli baat — Nifty ne aaj flat band diya, lekin volume pichhle hafte se pachees percent zyada tha. Doosri — F I I ne cash market me lagataar teesre din buying ki hai. Aur teesri baat, jo sabse important hai — R B I ki policy meeting is hafte hai, aur banking stocks pehle se hi position bana rahe hain.

segments.say: Namaste, main Rajesh. Aaj market kholne se pehle teen cheezein aapko pata honi chahiye. Teesri wali sabse zaroori hai.
Ab is number ko dhyan se dekhiye.

card.headline: Poori list aur levels ke liye

caption:
Aaj ka pre-market brief — Nifty ka volume, FII flow, aur is hafte ki RBI policy meeting.

Poori list aur levels chahiye? Comment karo "MARKET".
